image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of an antique aneroid barometer. The instrument features a circular dial with a brass or gold-toned bezel and a glass cover. The face is off-white/cream with black numerical markings (likely inches of mercury) and weather condition text (e.g., 'Rain', 'Change', 'Fair'). Two hands are visible: a long black indicator hand and a shorter reference hand. The casing appears to be dark wood. The lighting creates a vignette effect, darker at the corners.
